title: Steam Purity - Methods of Sampling and Test
clause_1_scope: This standard prescribes the method of sampling and tests for steam purity.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Methods of sampling and test (physical and chemical) for water and wastewater, Part 35: Silica
Methods of sampling and test (physical and chemical) for water and wastewater, Part 42: Copper

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
